name: Kisaragi Souko
source:
“Huh? Really? Heehee—
Then I'll treat you again next time, okay?”

Kazuhito's childhood friend, skilled in cooking.

She's timid and shy, but becomes friendly once she opens up. She enjoys looking after others, especially Kazuhito.

Though emotionally fragile, she does her best to face the threats of the Ruined World.

Class: Dreamer
Reality-Altering Ability: Divine Protection — a protective barrier born from her desire to keep herself safe. Though it has extremely low offensive capability, its defensive power is above average.
